Chapter 469: Chapter 12 Immortal King’s Demeanor (Please Subscribe)

Within the Huailong Palace, numerous True Immortal dragon descendants were filled with fear.

After the initial confusion, these dragon descendants realized that the entity taking action against them was very likely a certain Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King.

If not a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King, who else could effortlessly suppress dozens of True Immortal dragon descendants, as well as the half-step Immortal King, the Huailong Palace Master who had passed the Bodily Tribulation, as if lifting a light object?

If not a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King, who could ignore the core water veins of the Jiujang Domain, treat the million-mile-large Huailong Palace as a plaything, and grasp it in the palm?

“Palace Master, when did we offend an Immortal King?”

“Yes, Palace Master, what exactly happened?”

...

“A Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King, what kind of being is that, and why would they bother to take action against ants like us?”

…

One after another, the True Immortal dragon descendants looked toward the Huailong Palace Master, asking anxiously.

Although they were all trapped within the Huailong Palace, unable to go out, basic communication was still possible.

The Huailong Palace Master’s expression was gloomy as she scanned the frightened True Immortal dragon descendants.

Her brows involuntarily furrowed deeply.

How would she know when the Huailong Palace had offended a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King?

Although the Huailong Palace acted domineeringly, it knew whom to target; beings or powers with potential backing from an Immortal King were definitely not to be offended but were well provided for instead.

“Which Immortal King is it?”

Although the Huailong Palace Master was also afraid, she realized that fear was meaningless. If the Immortal King truly wanted to kill them, none of the dragon descendants would likely survive.

“Hmm?”

The Huailong Palace Master looked up toward the outside of the Huailong Palace.

She immediately saw the colossal figure looming over them.

The million-mile-large Huailong Palace was merely one-tenth the size of the figure’s palm. Compared to this immense being, the Huailong Palace Master felt incredibly insignificant, unable to even fully look up at Lin Yuan’s complete form.

“This must be the Immortal King who took action against my Huailong Palace…” the Huailong Palace Master had her suspicions.

The other True Immortal dragon descendants also saw Lin Yuan, but being too close, they couldn’t see him in full, only confirming that this Immortal King had a human form.

Having a human form didn’t necessarily mean belonging to the Human Race.

“Great Immortal King, all beings of the Huailong Palace are willing to submit.” the Huailong Palace Master immediately said with utmost respect.

She understood that the fate of the entire Huailong Palace depended on the whim of this mysterious Immortal King before her.

“Submit?”

Lin Yuan smirked slightly.

He then looked at the Cangqing Immortal beside him, “What do you think?”

“How do I see it?” the Cangqing Immortal was trembling with fear, unsure why Lin Yuan was asking him at this time.

“That is…”

The Huailong Palace Master looked to the side and immediately saw the Cangqing Immortal.

Although to them he too was a monstrous figure, the perspective offered by the distance allowed them to vaguely make out his features.

“Is that Cangqing?”

The Huailong Palace Master’s heart turned cold.

Having warred with the Daode Immortal Sect for so many years, the Cangqing Immortal was all too familiar with her, and naturally, the Huailong Palace Master was also very familiar with Cangqing.

Yet the more so, the more desperate the Huailong Palace Master felt.

The enmity between the Huailong Palace and the Daode Immortal Sect was too significant; they had fought for hundreds of thousands of years, causing countless casualties among their forces.

Now that the Huailong Palace had fallen into the hands of the Cangqing Immortal, could there be any good outcome?

“Forget it.”

“I’ll decide.”

Lin Yuan noticed that the Cangqing Immortal dared not make a decision and his thoughts shifted slightly.

In the palm of his hand, the Huailong Palace began to disintegrate, every substance, whether it was living or non-living, was reduced to the most basic Origin Source of essence.

Eventually, it formed an essence pill the size of a thumb.

Even for Lin Yuan, the essence pill refined from all the True Immortal dragon descendants of the Huailong Palace, including the Palace Master, who was a half-step Immortal King that had passed the Bodily Tribulation, as well as the Palace itself, had an inconsequentially small effect.

Although the Cangqing Immortal dared not make a decision, Lin Yuan could still sense his intentions.

That was to eradicate future troubles.

Moreover, the Huailong Palace had significant karma with Jun Dongjin, as the former had severely wounded the latter, reducing his chances of breaking through to the Unity Path Stage.

So Lin Yuan never had any intention of sparing the Huailong Palace.

…

“The Huailong Palace… is no more….”

The Cangqing Immortal looked dazed, not from pity or sympathy,

but because the Huailong Palace, with hundreds of thousands of years of heritage, had come to such a dramatically abrupt end.

“The power of the Martial Ancestor….” the Cangqing Immortal stealthily glanced at Lin Yuan’s silhouette, growing ever more trembling inside.

Above all, if an Immortal King were to take action against the Huailong Palace, he indeed could achieve what Lin Yuan had done.

Breaking through numerous barriers, seizing the entire Huailong Palace.

Various descriptions collected by the Daode Immortal Sect about Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings could corroborate this.

But the precondition was that this Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King must be nearby the Huailong Palace, and not too far away. Only at such proximity could the full might of a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King be exhibited.

The farther the distance, the more dissipated the power of the same strike becomes, not to mention that Lin Yuan was across two Great Realms when he effortlessly summoned the entire Huailong Palace. This involves not merely an issue of distance,

but rather an insight into the essence of heaven and earth, along with mastery over the mysteries of space.

In general, Lin Yuan’s power seemed somewhat exceeding the standard, surpassing the limits of what a normal Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King could achieve.

The Huailong Palace Master from beginning to the end had no clue that she and the entire Huailong Palace had instantly traversed billions of miles to Martial Temple, which is why she thought Lin Yuan was a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King.

But the Cangqing Immortal saw everything clearly, the Huailong Palace was originally located in the Jiujang Domain, yet Lin Yuan had easily captured it.

“The little one from back then, upon our next meeting, not only became an Immortal King but also within the ranks of Immortal Kings, can be considered…”
